name: Boleslaus II of Bohemia
contribution: Duke of Bohemia from 972 until his death in 999.

checks.lead: Boleslaus II the Pious (Czech: Boleslav II. Pobožný, Polish: Bolesław II Pobożny; c. 932 – 7 February 999), a member of the Přemyslid dynasty, was Duke of Bohemia from 972 until his death in 999.
